title: Figure 1: road map of incident location near Woodland and Knights Landing, California
description: Road map of the area north of Davis, California, showing Woodland, Zamora and Knights Landing with Interstate 5 and Routes 16 and 113, and a black oval marking the incident area northwest of Woodland. Caption: "Figure 1. Map indicating location of incident. The location of the incident is within the oval circle on the map." Text under "Location Overview and Weather Conditions" places the incident between Woodland and Knight's Landing on County Road 102.
